Received, thank you. The prompt looks great. Two quick clarifying questions:

1) For the benchmarking piece, is it okay to use a small synthetic dataset or should I use an open public dataset you expect?
2) For reproducibility, can I include a link to a small pretrained public model (e.g., huggingface) or must everything be built from scratch?

Also: I have a prior commitment on Thurs afternoon (12/17). If possible, could I ask for a 24-hour extension to submit by end-of-day Friday (12/18)? No problem if not.

Appreciate it,

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for the questions. Quick answers:

1) Use a small public dataset (OpenML or a public huggingface dataset is fine). Synthetic is okay for parts of the exercise, but please include at least one real open dataset for the benchmarking section.
2) Linking to a public pretrained model on Hugging Face is fine — we only ask that you do not include private/proprietary weights in the submission. 

We can accommodate the short extension — new deadline: Friday, 2026-12-18 23:59 PT.

I'll loop Marcus in for any technical follow-ups, but otherwise good to go. Good luck and reach out if anything else comes up.

Best,
